subject: art-design

items.q: Is textiles a genuine art and design discipline?
items.correct: Yes — it has its own techniques and creative process.
items.why: Textile art uses dyeing, printing, weaving and stitching.

items.q: Does textile design need planning and sampling?
items.correct: Yes — designs are developed through samples and experiments.
items.misconception: No, you make the final piece straight away.
items.random_wrong: Colour and pattern need no thought.
items.why: Artists test materials, colour and pattern first.
